mechanism_narrative: The historically low federal funds rate of 0.39% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns from 2008-12-15 despite the federal funds rate being at 0.39%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the CPI index exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, which increases equity risk premiums and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and employment level (PAYEMS) signals a deepening labor market crisis, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS monthly change < -100000
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE monthly change exceeds 0.3pp and PAYEMS monthly change is below -100000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime defined by unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% and quarterly GDP growth being negative, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and GDPC1 quarterly growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) at 106.12, indicating strong economic output, compresses risk and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns from 2008-12-15 despite INDPRO being at 106.12.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a weakening housing market, which increases equity risk and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in instances where HOUST monthly change is below -10%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a deepening housing market crisis, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change < -10% AND RSAFS monthly change < -10%
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in instances where HOUST monthly change is below -10% and RSAFS monthly change is below -10%.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn regime defined by housing starts below 800 and residential sales below 350000, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in instances where HOUST < 800 and RSAFS < 350000.
